mapper.sql: s.id, s.project_id, s.slot_type, s.current_version_id, s.status, s.created_at, v.version_no AS current_version_no
mapper.select: SELECT FROM deliverable_slot s LEFT JOIN slot_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE s.slot_type WHEN 'requirements' THEN 1 WHEN 'ia' THEN 2 WHEN 'design' THEN 3 WHEN 'prototype' THEN 4 WHEN 'figma' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END
SELECT FROM deliverable_slot s LEFT JOIN slot_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.project_id = #{projectId} AND s.slot_type = #{slotType}
SELECT FROM deliverable_slot s LEFT JOIN slot_version v ON v.id = s.current_version_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT id, project_id, slot_type, current_version_id, status, created_at FROM deliverable_slot WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deliverable_slot (project_id, slot_type, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{slotType}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'empty'))
mapper.update: UPDATE deliverable_slot SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
